statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: Governance or vacuous for the runtime, with the reason

entries.rule: Entry at threshold step 0 with EFFORT_CUE, a calibration, no pace target; one step per executed comparable session

fixCycle: SSCTR R7B-F3 a: the strides keep last week's count in the introduction week

entries.rule: Disclosed as a new harder session with an easy alternative kept without penalty; declining keeps the easy plan, revisited at the next boundary
A single adverse response repeats; two within 14 days regress; clinical routes; missing eligibility is ASK
entries.note: The frozen R6/R7-A runtime behaviour, unchanged by R7-B; covered by the inherited suite (673 tests at the baseline, all passing on the R7-B runtime with the recorded test changes). Graduated athletes use the same gates.

entries.rule: Strides optional for WALK_JOG-, RESTART- or EASY_LOW-started athletes and runExperience NONE/NOVICE
fixCycle: SSCTR R7B-F3 b: race-day warm-up strides are optional where strides are optional

entries.rule: Graduation never exempts the race-day completion rule and never satisfies the event-specific prerequisite by itself
Strides after walk/jog or restart exit follow the frozen runtime and R6-RUN-QUALITY C5, C9, C12, C13
entries.note: The frozen R6/R7-A runtime behaviour, unchanged by R7-B; covered by the inherited suite (673 tests at the baseline, all passing on the R7-B runtime with the recorded test changes).

entries.rule: Only a current VO2_STYLE task with every P14 input; short intervals, hills, time trial and race simulation stay LATER_GATE; an ambiguous category is ASK
fixCycle: SSCTR R7B-F2: the task is current through policy:operational.return.moderateMaxDays after its last performance, checked at every prescription date

entries.rule: Every R6 quality gate; BUILD, DEVELOPMENT or NEXT_BLOCK only; week 1 only inside the reported minutes; single quality session, never next to the long run
entries.note: Conservative: the familiar bouts start after the two established easy weeks of the EASY_CURRENT class, never in week 1.

entries.rule: The dose is held exactly; SSCTR-R2-P07 permits only fewer repetitions after repeated last-repetition degradation; otherwise threshold ladder step 0 or easy
entries.note: Held exactly; repeated adverse responses withdraw the bouts (threshold ladder from step 0). The P07 fewer-repetition path is not used: it needs a last-repetition degradation record the observation contract does not carry (owner Product/Data).
fixCycle: SSCTR R7B-F5: the threshold session that replaces paused bouts says it is a different, lower stimulus

entries.rule: The familiar target is a field-session anchor only (never LT2, CS, MLSS, VO2max or race pace); effort co-primary; changed conditions invalidate reuse
entries.note: Comparable conditions are an intake input; a change of conditions inside a program needs a new intake (no in-program conditions observation exists).

entries.rule: After a SHORT break the first quality slot runs easy; no quality in RETURN or RESTART; after any interruption the familiar status lapses
fixCycle: SSCTR R7B-F2: the bouts lapse once the task stops being current (also after an event)

entries.rule: Never an executed threshold session for the event-specific prerequisite, the taper peak or the race touch

entries.rule: Admission adds no dose: R6 goal dose by role, R6 establishment and progression; no load derived from sex, size or another exercise
tests: test/r7b-binding.test.mjs::R7-B conformance: every planned run belongs

entries.rule: Skill admissibility unchanged; HIGH only when familiar or reached through a ladder; equipment never implies competence

entries.note: Used only as ordinal comparisons (within one step, HIGH eccentric); no sum exists in the runtime.

entries.rule: The derived session recovery-cost class is explanatory and a tie-break only; never double counted

entries.rule: SINGLE_IMPLEMENT progresses by the per-implement step, or by repetitions when that implement step is unavailable; never a fabricated load

entries.rule: BAND_TENSION and ASSISTED_BODYWEIGHT never carry kilograms; repetitions inside the goal range; a level change is athlete-reported and confirmed, never inferred

entries.rule: Alternatives replace, never add; R6 doses, rest and preparation by role; no new exercise in TAPER, RACE_WEEK or POST_EVENT

entries.rule: Goal-context alternatives spread across the listed patterns before any repeats; the id tie-break only within a pattern

tests: test/r7b-binding.test.mjs::R7-B conformance: every planned run belongs

tests: test/r7b-review-fixes.test.mjs::Q-R7B-01 / QE-R7B-02: an accepted ladder step
